title: Balance_createBalanceOrder_Response_200
description: Represents an order linked to a balance definition, including amount, due date, and transaction details.

balanceDefinitionId.description: Optional unique identifier (UUID) of the associated balance definition.

contactId.description: Unique identifier of the contact placing the order (must be ≥ 1).

createdAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp indicating when the order was created.

dueAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp specifying when the order is due in the future.

expiresAt.description: Optional RFC3339 timestamp defining order expiration in the future.

id.description: Unique identifier for the balance order.

loyaltyProgramId.description: Unique identifier of the loyalty program associated with the order.

meta.description: Optional metadata associated with the order.

processedAt.description: Optional RFC3339 timestamp indicating when the order was processed.

transactionid.description: Optional reference to the associated transaction ID.

updatedAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp indicating the last update to the order.
